A few TIPS for perfect Bomboloni 🤍🍩

1️⃣ Always weight your ingredients using a scale for accurate measurements. Precision makes a huge difference in texture.

2️⃣ Knead the dough until smooth and elastic - don't overmix, but make sure gluten is properly developed.

3️⃣ Do the windowpane test. If the dough stretches thin without tearing, it's ready.

4️⃣ Let the dough proof patiently until doubled in size. Proper proofing gives that soft, airy inside.

5️⃣ Keep the oil temperature between 160–170°C. Too hot will brown fast, too low will absorb oil.

6️⃣ Flip gently only once, when one side turns golden. This helps maintain shape and develop the perfect white ring.

Consistency + patience = perfect Bomboloni every time ✨🤍
